answer: Locks are published in horizon, expire in quill, and walnut lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 135 aliases therefore needs 81 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 692 identities would post 3801 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
